parameters.help_en:
The fileKey of the APP-ICP filing details screenshot.

How to query ICP filing information:
Go to the MIIT Service Platform (https://beian.miit.gov.cn/#/Integrated/recordQuery) to query ICP filing information and navigate to the details page.

ICP filing file information uploaded to OSS. File upload requirements:

The file name must not contain Chinese characters or special characters.
Only images in jpg, png, gif, or jpeg format are supported. The image size must not exceed 5 MB.
The screenshot must contain the complete URL.
Set the filing type to "APP".
The "Principal Unit Name" must exactly match the enterprise or organization name associated with the signature qualification.
The ICP filing/license number must be complete and clearly visible.
The "Service Name" must exactly match the "Signature Name".

Obtain the fileKey as follows: https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2833114.html
parameters.help_zh:
APP-ICP备案详情截图fileKey。

ICP备案查询方法：
前往 工信部服务平台 (https://beian.miit.gov.cn/#/Integrated/recordQuery) 查询ICP备案 ，并进入详情页。

上传到OSS的ICP 备案文件信息。文件上传要求：

待上传的文件命名不可包含中文和特殊字符。
仅支持jpg、png、gif、jpeg格式的图片，图片不大于5MB。
截图中包含完整的网址。
搜索备案类型选择“APP”。
“主办单位名称”需和签名关联资质的企事业单位名称完全一致。
有完整清晰的ICP备案/许可证号。
“服务名称”需和“签名名称”完全一致。

fileKey的获取方式如下：https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2833114.html
